listing.tagline: A sepia parchment and charcoal ink color theme
listing.description: Warm parchment backgrounds with near-black ink in light mode, and parchment text on charcoal in dark mode. The accent is the ink color, so the whole hub reads in two tones. It is colors only, with no CSS or JS, so the install does not ask.
